scope: First 8 of the T12 60+24+84 question set. Cover the 4 boundary layers (knowable / unknowable / belief / emotion) and 4 of the 6 expression classes (answer / challenge / comfort / cross_book_hearsay). The remaining 76 cases (full 60 boundary + 20 expression) are not yet authored; this pilot is a small-budget, evidence-anchored first slice to validate the dataset / runner / schema. Not whole-book persona, not T17 six-combination matrix, not the full 24-pair A/B expression comparison.
